description: Draw a persistent highlight overlay around an element (by CSS selector or aria ref). Useful for screenshots and video recording to show what the agent is focusing on. Does not affect page behavior.

frameSelector.description: Optional CSS selector for an iframe. When set, selector/ref resolve inside that frame.

label.description: Optional text label shown above the highlight; also used as the key for browser_hide_highlight.

ref.description: aria-ref from browser_snapshot, for example e12. Provide exactly one of selector or ref.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide exactly one of selector or ref.

style.description: Optional extra inline CSS for the overlay, e.g. 'outline: 3px dashed lime'.

name: browser_highlight
